subject.title: feat: verify AI access during macOS onboarding before the first chat

question: Should the permanent macOS first-run path use new core gateway crestodian.setup.detect/activate RPCs for verified inference setup, or should this stay on the existing Crestodian conversation/wizard contract?
rationale: The PR adds operator-admin protocol surface and a persistent config/auth setup path, so the API direction should be an explicit maintainer choice even though the linked issue and evidence support the approach.

options.title: Accept structured setup API after fixes
options.body: Merge the new detect/activate direction once the target-scoping, rollback, write-budget, and proof gaps are fixed.

options.title: Keep conversation or wizard setup only
options.body: Reject the new protocol surface and require the macOS app to drive the existing setup conversation or wizard APIs instead.

options.title: Narrow the API before merge
options.body: Keep the user-visible Connect your AI flow but move persistence behind a smaller existing setup contract before landing.

recommendation.title: Accept structured setup API after fixes
recommendation.body: Merge the new detect/activate direction once the target-scoping, rollback, write-budget, and proof gaps are fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: The same person is the recent author of the current Crestodian onboarding implementation and the PR author for the proposed replacement path.
